extName.message: DOOM (1993) Offline - No Internet Easter Egg

extDescription.message: Play authentic classic Doom offline when internet dies. 100% offline WebAssembly retro FPS engine.

dino_subtitle.message: Play Doom while waiting for internet to return.

dino_chk_notify.message: Notify me when connection is restored

dino_rotate_prompt.message: Rotate your phone to landscape for fullscreen gameplay

online_alert_desc.message: Internet is back. Game has been paused so you don't lose progress.

start_prompt_desc.message: Official DOOM1.WAD Shareware by id Software (1993)

start_prompt_hint.message: Use keyboard (WASD / Arrows / Space / Ctrl) or click to aim with mouse.

mouse_tip.message: 💡 Click on game canvas to enable Mouse Look (Pointer Lock).

wad_drag_sub.message: Supports DOOM.WAD, DOOM2.WAD, TNT.WAD, PLUTONIA.WAD, SIGIL.WAD, or PWADs.

hint_esc_mouse.message: Press ESC to pause the game and release your mouse

save_offline_title.message: Do you want to save it to play offline?

save_offline_desc.message: We will save the game in your browser cache so you can play anytime, even without an internet connection.

saving_offline.message: Saving game assets to local storage...

save_offline_done.message: ✅ Successfully saved! Ready for offline play.
